svg.text: XMP is the program: numbers, points, recipes and pointers
DSC03049.xmp · 36,775 bytes of plain RDF/XML · open it in any text editor
a gentle pull-down of shadows and midtones;
anything that won't fit an attribute
geometry and thresholds only: no pixels, nothing to store
a model's output can't be re-derived exactly, so the XMP
keeps an MD5 (MaskDigest, pm_patch …) and an Origin
the pixels themselves live in the ACR
